component-o.description-s: 20V common-drain dual N-channel MOSFET for Li-ion battery protection pairs (uni/bi-directional load switch); ESD protected (internal 1.8k gate resistors + gate-source zeners); 7A, RDS(on) <20mR @4.5V, <23mR @2.5V, <28mR @1.8V; TSSOP-8

stdpins-ao.2c: S1 (pins 2+3, tie together): battery cell negative side of the protection pair

stdpins-ao.6c: S2 (pins 6+7, tie together): pack negative terminal side

stdpins-ao.1c: D1/D2 (pins 1+8, tie together): internal common-drain node — no external connection required beyond joining the two pins

cfgpins-ao.4c: gate of the discharge FET: drive from the protection IC's DO output (e.g. S-8261 DO); internal 1.8k series resistor and gate-source ESD zener; VGS abs max +-8V; never float in operation

cfgpins-ao.5c: gate of the charge FET: drive from the protection IC's CO output (e.g. S-8261 CO); internal 1.8k series resistor and gate-source ESD zener; VGS abs max +-8V; never float in operation
